agentchanges.only.team: Only the app does this, since it reaches other people or changes who works on the project: open the project in Idiograph, Project settings, Working together. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.only.send: Only the app shares a copy of a project, since it goes to another person: in Idiograph, Share a copy on the project's menu on Home. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.only.names: Only the app takes a name off the list of names to replace, since the list is copied nowhere and no undo can put it back: in Idiograph, Project settings, Names to replace. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.only.settings: Only the app changes its settings, since they are the app's and no project's, so no undo reaches them: in Idiograph, Settings. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.no_files: No file of the project changed.
agentchanges.removed: Removed from Idiograph's list, its folder left as it is.
agentchanges.removed_trash: Removed from Idiograph, its folder moved to the {where}.
agentchanges.head: {changes} by agents in {project}, in {runs}, newest first.
agentchanges.undo.no_run: No run of this project is called {id}. agents changes lists them.
agentchanges.undo.already: Run {id} is undone already, by run {by}. Undo that run to have it back.
agentchanges.undo.folder: Run {id} renamed a participant's folder, so it is not undone whole: rename the folder back first with participant rename and --folder, then undo the run. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo.refused: Run {id} is not undone, since undoing it would lose these later changes:
agentchanges.undo.later: {what}, changed after the run's last change.
agentchanges.undo.between: {what}, changed by someone else between the run's changes.
agentchanges.undo.copies_gone: Run {id}'s restore point no longer holds {what}, so it is not undone. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo.demo: The demo keeps no restore points. Reset demo puts it back as it ships.
agentchanges.undo.would: Undoing run {id}, {changes}, would put the project back as it was before its first change:
agentchanges.undo.done: Run {id}, {changes}, is undone: the project is back as it was before its first change.
agentchanges.undo.gone: Taken away, as the run made them: {what}.
agentchanges.undo.again: The undo is run {id}, which undoes it in its turn.

agentchanges.holds_cleared.one: {n} action that waited was cleared when approvals were removed.
agentchanges.holds_cleared.other: {n} actions that waited were cleared when approvals were removed.

agentchanges.undo_change.none_named: Name the change to undo by its id, c12, as agents changes gives it. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.no_change: No change of this project is called {id}. agents changes lists them.
agentchanges.undo_change.already: Change {id} is undone already, by run {by}. Undo that run to have it back.
agentchanges.undo_change.run_undone: Change {id} is undone already, with its run {run}.
agentchanges.undo_change.no_copies: Change {id} keeps no copy of its files as they were before it, so it is undone only with its run: agents undo-run {run}. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.refused: Not undone, since undoing it would lose a later change:
agentchanges.undo_change.copies_gone: The restore points no longer hold {what} as it was, so it is not undone. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.would: Undoing {ids} would put each file back as it was just before the change:
agentchanges.undo_change.done: Undone: {ids}. Each file is back as it was just before the change.
agentchanges.op.board_duplicate: Made a copy of a board
agentchanges.op.board_restore: Restored a revision of a board
agentchanges.op.board_revision: Saved a revision of a board
agentchanges.op.board_current: Made a board the Current board
agentchanges.op.board_complete: Marked the PETs complete, or reopened them
agentchanges.op.board_copy: Copied a PET to another board
agentchanges.op.board_canvas: Put a board on the canvas
agentchanges.op.gets_take: Took a participant's changes into the GETs
agentchanges.op.turn_edit: Edited a passage of the transcript
agentchanges.op.turn_note: Wrote a note on the interviewer's words
agentchanges.op.participant_complete: Marked statements complete, or reopened them
